title: NeetCode 150 Practice Roadmap
description: A curated list of the 150 most popular coding interview questions covering all major data structures and algorithm categories.

title: Arrays & Hashing Course - Neetcode
description: Comprehensive guide to static and dynamic arrays, hash maps, hash sets, and their search/insert complexities.

title: Two Pointer Technique - Neetcode
description: Learn the two-pointer technique for optimized search in sorted arrays and linear data structures.

title: Sliding Window Pattern - Neetcode
description: Master the sliding window algorithm to solve contiguous subarray and substring problems efficiently.

title: Linked Lists & Pointers - Neetcode
description: Tutorial on singly, doubly, and circular linked lists, including reversal, cycle detection, and merging lists.

title: Binary Search Mastery - Neetcode
description: Understanding the divide-and-conquer binary search algorithm on sorted intervals and custom search spaces.

title: Binary Trees & BST - Neetcode
description: Detailed explanation of binary trees, binary search trees (BST), preorder, inorder, postorder, and level-order traversal algorithms.

title: Tries / Prefix Trees - Neetcode
description: Learn trie nodes and character mapping for optimized prefix searches, auto-completion systems, and dictionary storage.

title: Graphs BFS, DFS & Dijkstra - Neetcode
description: Study graph representations (adjacency lists, matrices), Breadth-First Search, Depth-First Search, topological sort, and Dijkstra's shortest path.

title: Introduction to Dynamic Programming - Neetcode
description: Demystifying 1D and 2D Dynamic Programming using memoization (top-down) and tabulation (bottom-up) approaches.

title: Dynamic Programming Tutorial - GeeksforGeeks
description: Learn dynamic programming concepts, optimal substructure, overlapping subproblems, memoization, and tabulation with classic DP problems.

title: Graph Data Structure and Algorithms - GeeksforGeeks
description: Complete guide to graph representations, Breadth First Search (BFS), Depth First Search (DFS), Dijkstra shortest path, Prim's and Kruskal's MST algorithms.

title: Algorithms Roadmap - Roadmap.sh
description: Visualize standard coding algorithms, dynamic programming, sorting, searching, greedy approaches, and time complexity models.

title: Computer Science Roadmap - Roadmap.sh
description: A comprehensive guide mapping out standard computer science topics, operating system concepts, data structures, and networks.

title: System Design & Architecture - Roadmap.sh
description: Learn scalable web architectures, load balancers, caching strategies, database replication, sharding, CDN, and microservices.

title: Software Design Patterns - Roadmap.sh
description: Overview of creational, structural, and behavioral design patterns including Singleton, Factory, Observer, and Strategy.

title: Backend Developer Roadmap - Roadmap.sh
description: A step-by-step visual roadmap for learning backend development, APIs, servers, databases, caching, and security.

title: Java Collections Framework Guide - Oracle Docs
description: Official documentation explaining core Java Collection interfaces (List, Set, Map, Queue) and implementations (ArrayList, HashSet, HashMap).

title: Java Concurrency & Multithreading Docs
description: Java concurrency utilities (java.util.concurrent) including ExecutorService, thread pools, locks, semaphores, and concurrent maps.

title: Java Streams API Reference & Tutorial
description: Guide to functional operations on streams of elements, map-reduce transformations, filters, and parallel processing streams.

title: Python Collections Module Reference
description: Official reference guide for Python's specialized container datatypes (Counter, deque, OrderedDict, defaultdict, namedtuple).

title: Python Concurrency and Asyncio Reference
description: Documentation for writing concurrent code using the async/await syntax, event loops, tasks, coroutines, and thread executors.

title: C++ STL Vectors and Containers Reference
description: C++ Standard Template Library container class templates including vector, list, deque, map, set, unordered_map, and unordered_set.

title: C++ Concurrency and Thread Support Library
description: C++ standard library support for threads, mutual exclusion (mutex), condition variables, futures, and lock utilities.

title: JavaScript Standard Objects & Array Reference
description: MDN JavaScript Array, Set, Map, WeakMap, and typed array global objects standard documentation and methods.

title: JavaScript Asynchronous Programming MDN
description: MDN guide to event loop, callbacks, promises, async/await keywords, and handling network API requests concurrently.

title: Database Management Systems (DBMS) - GeeksforGeeks
description: Comprehensive DBMS tutorial covering SQL queries, normalization (1NF, 2NF, 3NF, BCNF), ACID properties, transactions, indexing, and relational algebra.

title: Operating Systems (OS) Concepts - GeeksforGeeks
description: OS tutorial explaining process management, CPU scheduling, deadlocks, memory management, virtual memory, paging, and file systems.

title: Computer Networks (CN) Guide - GeeksforGeeks
description: Detailed notes on OSI model, TCP/IP stack, IP routing, subnetting, HTTP/HTTPS protocols, DNS, routing algorithms, and socket programming.

title: Sorting & Searching Algorithms - GeeksforGeeks
description: Guide to Quick Sort, Merge Sort, Heap Sort, Bubble Sort, Binary Search, and their time and space complexity analyses.

title: Greedy Algorithms and Tutorials - GeeksforGeeks
description: Introduction to greedy programming paradigm with classic problems like Huffman Coding, fractional knapsack, and activity selection.

title: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) Concepts
description: Introduction to core object-oriented programming principles: polymorphism, inheritance, encapsulation, and abstraction with class structures.
